amendments.reason: PUB-02 required sale-mode and availability filters and the admin product update workflow required optimistic concurrency, but the frozen OpenAPI omitted those details.
changes: GET /products adds optional saleMode (existing enum) and available (boolean) query filters.
PATCH /admin/products/{id} now references the existing ProductPatch DTO with required expectedVersion; POST remains ProductWrite.
amendments.migration: None; query filters are additive and expectedVersion uses the existing product version field.

amendments.reason: POST /admin/media must report missing storage configuration without returning a fabricated URL or mislabeling a storage outage as a database failure.
changes: Add MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE to the existing API error code vocabulary for HTTP 503 media storage failures.
amendments.migration: None; the existing error envelope and route remain unchanged.

amendments.reason: Planning 03/05 requires audit time filters, but the frozen OpenAPI omitted the existing from/to query fields.
changes: GET /admin/audit-logs adds optional from and to query parameters with date-time format.
amendments.migration: None; the route and authorization remain unchanged.

amendments.reason: The settings DTO was unbounded despite the planning requirement for a business-settings allowlist.
changes: BusinessSettingsWrite.values allows only shippingZones, codEnabled, checkoutLimits, and supportWindows with array/boolean/object/object value types.
amendments.migration: None; actual zone, fee, limit, and support-window values remain owner-configured.

amendments.reason: StoryWrite and PageWrite content arrays lacked item schemas although planning requires allowlisted safe rich text.
changes: Add bounded text-only content block variants and item schemas for story sections, media, motifs, product IDs, and page blocks.
amendments.migration: None; existing content must be validated before publication.

amendments.reason: The staff dashboard requires a low-stock field, but the inventory model has no threshold and the owner has not configured one.
changes: Return lowStock as null and show an unconfigured state until a future approved threshold exists; do not report an invented zero count.
amendments.migration: None; no threshold setting or inventory field is added.

amendments.reason: Products link stories by ObjectId, while P04 product detail must resolve linked content through P08 without adding a public API route.
changes: Add the internal P08 getPublishedStoryById(storyId, { session }) port; it returns the existing story DTO only for published records and preserves the referenced record locale.
amendments.migration: None; this is an internal read port with no stored-data change.

amendments.reason: The frozen API requires guest order OTP access and atomic proof revocation during claim, while guest restricted credentials must stay in P02's identity subsystem.
changes: P02 exposes the existing proof issuer plus internal proof authentication, scoped middleware, and order-id revocation methods; P05 owns code/email challenge matching, OTP verification, and the existing public guest access operations.
P05 stores the guest proof in a dedicated HttpOnly cookie name separate from the appeal credential.
amendments.migration: None; the existing restricted_proofs model, scopes, and public API contract are unchanged.

amendments.reason: The frozen COD collection request requires evidence, but the Order snapshot has no field for immutable collection records.
changes: P05 persists one immutable full-balance COD collection per order and atomically commits it with Order paid status and amount; partial capture is not enabled.
amendments.migration: Create the additive cod_collections collection/index; existing Orders are unaffected.

amendments.reason: Address update behavior requires partial fields and expectedVersion, but the OpenAPI PATCH operation referenced the create-only AddressWrite DTO.
changes: PATCH /account/addresses/{id} references the existing AddressPatch DTO; the DTO is exposed as an OpenAPI component.
amendments.migration: None; no route or stored field changes.

amendments.reason: Pending COD limits are required to protect held inventory, but the existing checkoutLimits object had no documented key or safe enablement rule.
changes: checkoutLimits allows only positive integer maxPendingCodOrders; absence means COD checkout is disabled, with no invented default.
amendments.migration: None; owners configure this value through existing business settings.

amendments.reason: Business settings already reserved shippingZones for owner-supplied shipping fees, but its item structure was unspecified and checkout had no configured-zone quote adapter.
changes: shippingZones items contain exactly id, provinceNames, and non-negative integer feeVnd; configured province names are unique across zones after case, Vietnamese diacritic, and whitespace normalization.
Checkout quotes only an exact normalized recipient province match from configured zones; missing, unmatched, malformed, or ambiguous data remains unavailable and no fee is inferred.
amendments.migration: None; owners must review and enter actual zones and VND fees before shipping quotes or checkout become available.
